captions.text: Resgrid Dispatch brings calls, units, personnel, the map,
and notes into one console.
This walkthrough is for dispatchers and other authorized coordinators
who need to find the right resource and maintain its recorded state.
We use a fictional firehouse, but the same console pattern can support
community response teams, search and rescue, security operations, wildland
contractors, and industrial response.
